papers.title: Burden and factors associated with hospitalization among patients with chronic Diseases at a tertiary Hospital in Wolaita Zone, South Ethiopia: A Cross-sectional study
papers.translated_title: 埃塞俄比亚南部沃莱塔地区某三级医院慢性病患者住院负担及相关因素：一项横断面研究
papers.author: Koyra, H. C.
papers.summary: Background Chronic diseases are the leading causes of illness, disability, and death worldwide, with a disproportionate burden in low- and middle-income countries. Hospitalization is a critical outcome in chronic disease management, reflecting disease severity, treatment failure, and healthcare utilization. However, data on hospitalization burden and its associated factors among chronic disease patients in Ethiopia, are limited. This study aimed to determine the rate of hospitalization and its associated factors among patients with chronic diseases attending a tertiary hospital in Wolaita Zone, South Ethiopia. Methods A facility-based cross-sectional study was conducted among 321 patients with chronic diseases attending the chronic follow-up clinic at Wolaita Sodo University Comprehensive Specialized Hospital from November to December 2022. Consecutive recruitment was used, with unique medical record numbers tracked to prevent double recruitment. Data were collected through structured questionnaires and medical record review. Negative binomial regression was used to identify factors associated with hospitalization rate, with incidence rate ratios (IRR) and 95% confidence intervals (CI) reported. A p-value < 0.05 was considered statistically significant. Results Of the 321 participants, 66% reported at least one hospitalization while on treatment, with a mean of 1.70 {+/-} 1.81 hospitalizations per patient. Drug discontinuation was the most frequently documented reason for hospitalization (39.5%), followed by disease complications (22.3%) and infections (11.7%). Multimorbidity was prevalent, with the majority (59.8%) had 2-3 conditions, and a mean of 2.40 {+/-} 1.02 chronic diseases per patient. Male sex was associated with a higher hospitalization rate, while regular physical exercise was associated with a lower number of hospitalizations. Conclusion This study found a high burden of hospitalization among chronic disease patients, with drug discontinuation being the leading documented reason. Male sex and regular physical exercise were significantly associated highlighting the need for medication adherence support programs and structured exercise programs integrated into routine chronic disease care, as well as gender-sensitive interventions.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 慢性病是全球疾病、残疾和死亡的主要原因，在中低收入国家负担尤为沉重。住院是慢性病管理中的一个关键结局，反映了疾病严重程度、治疗失败和医疗资源利用情况。然而，关于埃塞俄比亚慢性病患者住院负担及其相关因素的数据有限。本研究旨在确定埃塞俄比亚南部沃莱塔地区一家三级医院就诊的慢性病患者住院率及其相关因素。方法 于2022年11月至12月在沃莱塔索多大学综合专科医院慢性随访门诊就诊的321名慢性病患者中开展了一项基于医疗机构的横断面研究。采用连续招募方式，并追踪唯一病历号以防止重复招募。通过结构化问卷和病历审查收集数据。采用负二项回归确定与住院率相关的因素，报告发病率比（IRR）和95%置信区间（CI）。p值<0.05被认为具有统计学意义。结果 在321名参与者中，66%报告在治疗期间至少住院一次，平均每名患者住院1.70±1.81次。停药是最常记录的住院原因（39.5%），其次是疾病并发症（22.3%）和感染（11.7%）。多病共存普遍存在，大多数（59.8%）患有2-3种疾病，平均每名患者患有2.40±1.02种慢性病。男性与较高的住院率相关，而规律体育锻炼与较低的住院次数相关。结论 本研究发现慢性病患者住院负担较高，停药是主要的记录原因。男性和规律体育锻炼与住院率显著相关，凸显了将用药依从性支持项目和结构化运动项目整合到常规慢性病护理中的必要性，以及采取性别敏感干预措施的需要。

papers.title: Pixel-Level Quantification of Subcutaneous Shear-Wave Velocity Heterogeneity for Grading Lymphatic Obstruction in Breast Cancer-Related Lymphedema
papers.translated_title: 乳腺癌相关淋巴水肿中皮下剪切波速度异质性的像素级量化用于淋巴管阻塞分级
papers.author: Hoe, Z. Y.
papers.summary: Objectives: To develop and validate pixel data analysis (PDA) for reconstructing pixel-level shear-wave velocity (SWV) from saved Holder-Optimized Elastography (HOE) elastograms and to determine whether whole-field subcutaneous heterogeneity provides a quantitative signature of lymphatic obstruction compared with visual high-velocity-area (HVA) counting and sparse manual region-of-interest (ROI) sampling. Materials and Methods: In this cross-sectional study, 110 women after breast cancer surgery underwent lymphoscintigraphy and HOE, a pressure-minimized acquisition framework that preserves conventionally captured SWV information while additionally revealing spatial abnormalities attenuated by handheld acquisition. Reconstruction validation used 200 paired ROIs from 49 PACS-retrieved images spanning nearly the full displayed SWV range; reproducibility was assessed across 96 matched anatomical sites from 6 participants undergoing independently reacquired HOE examinations. PDA, visual HVA counting, and manual ROI sampling were evaluated on the same HOE-acquired elastograms in task-specific common complete-case cohorts. Results: PDA reconstructed the machine-reported SWV with near-zero error over a range of 1.17 - 9.97 m/s (mean difference, +0.0009 m/s; mean absolute error, 0.0075 m/s; 95% limits of agreement, -0.0202 to +0.0221 m/s). For subcutaneous variance, interobserver/intraobserver intraclass correlation coefficients were 0.709/0.799 for PDA and 0.178/0.560 for manual ROI sampling. In the primary no obstruction versus partial obstruction comparison (n = 93), forearm-pooled PDA subcutaneous variance ratio yielded the highest observed area under the curve (AUC, 0.858; 95% confidence interval, 0.771 - 0.946), compared with 0.820 for visual HVA counting and 0.794 for manual ROI sampling. PDA's subcutaneous variance ratio remained a leading feature across all three comparisons (AUC, 0.858 - 0.878), including partial versus total obstruction grading, where all three frameworks showed high discrimination. Conclusions: PDA accurately reconstructs pixel-level SWV from saved HOE elastograms and enables reproducible whole-field quantification of superficial SWE heterogeneity. Subcutaneous variance ratio was the leading quantitative PDA feature across lymphatic-obstruction comparisons and was particularly informative in partial obstruction. The same approach also enables retrospective quantitative reanalysis of compatible archived elastograms.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：开发并验证像素数据分析（PDA），用于从保存的Holder优化弹性成像（HOE）弹性图中重建像素级剪切波速度（SWV），并确定全区域皮下异质性是否提供淋巴管阻塞的定量特征，与视觉高速度区域（HVA）计数和稀疏手动感兴趣区（ROI）采样进行比较。材料与方法：在这项横断面研究中，110名乳腺癌术后女性接受了淋巴闪烁显像和HOE检查，HOE是一种压力最小化采集框架，在保留常规采集的SWV信息的同时，还能揭示被手持采集所衰减的空间异常。重建验证使用了来自49张PACS检索图像的200对配对ROI，覆盖了几乎整个显示的SWV范围；可重复性评估基于6名参与者的96个匹配解剖部位，这些参与者接受了独立重新采集的HOE检查。PDA、视觉HVA计数和手动ROI采样在任务特定的共同完整病例队列中，对同一HOE采集的弹性图进行评估。结果：PDA在1.17 - 9.97 m/s范围内以接近零的误差重建了机器报告的SWV（平均差值，+0.0009 m/s；平均绝对误差，0.0075 m/s；95%一致性界限，-0.0202至+0.0221 m/s）。对于皮下方差，PDA的观察者间/观察者内组内相关系数分别为0.709/0.799，而手动ROI采样为0.178/0.560。在主要的无阻塞与部分阻塞比较中（n = 93），前臂合并PDA皮下方差比产生了观察到的最高曲线下面积（AUC，0.858；95%置信区间，0.771 - 0.946），相比之下视觉HVA计数为0.820，手动ROI采样为0.794。PDA的皮下方差比在所有三项比较中均为领先特征（AUC，0.858 - 0.878），包括部分与完全阻塞分级，在该分级中三种框架均显示出高区分度。结论：PDA能够从保存的HOE弹性图中准确重建像素级SWV，并实现对浅表SWE异质性的可重复全区域定量。皮下方差比是淋巴管阻塞比较中领先的PDA定量特征，在部分阻塞中尤其具有信息价值。该方法还可对兼容的存档弹性图进行回顾性定量再分析。

papers.title: Professional Identity and Its Influencing Factors Among Nursing Interns: The Mediating Role of Career Adaptability Between Social Support and Professional Identity
papers.translated_title: 护理实习生职业认同及其影响因素：社会支持与职业认同之间职业适应性的中介作用
papers.author: Zhao, Y.
papers.summary: Purpose: The internship period is a critical stage for nursing students to develop professional values. This study aimed to investigate the current status of professional identity among nursing interns, analyze the effects of social support, perceived stress, psychological resilience, and career adaptability on professional identity, and explore the mediating role of career adaptability between social support and professional identity, so as to provide empirical evidence for enhancing professional identity and optimizing nursing talent training systems. Methods: Using convenience sampling, 407 nursing interns from a tertiary hospital in Quanzhou were selected as participants from May to July 2025. Data were collected using a general information questionnaire, the Social Support Scale, the Perceived Stress Scale, the Psychological Resilience Scale, the Professional Identity Questionnaire for Nursing Students, the Career Adaptability Scale, and the Questionnaire for Nurse Intention to Retention Employed. SPSS 26.0 was used for reliability analysis, descriptive analysis, independent samples t-test, one-way ANOVA, Pearson correlation analysis, and multiple linear regression analysis. The PROCESS macro was employed to test the mediating effect. Results: The total score of professional identity among nursing interns was (61.74{+/-}11.08), with 73.5% showing moderate professional identity. Parents' attitude toward nursing, reasons for choosing the profession, personal attitude toward the major, and employment intention showed statistically significant differences in professional identity scores (p<0.05). Pearson correlation analysis revealed that professional identity was significantly positively correlated with social support (r=0.474), psychological resilience (r=0.389), and career adaptability (r=0.609) (p<0.01), and significantly negatively correlated with perceived stress (r=-0.378) (p<0.01). Multiple linear regression analysis indicated that career adaptability ({beta}=0.309, p<0.001) and social support ({beta}=0.383, p<0.001) were significant positive predictors of professional identity, whereas reasons for choosing the profession ({beta}=-3.603, p=0.001) and employment intention ({beta}=-7.116, p<0.001) were significant negative predictors. The model explained 49.2% of the variance in professional identity. Mediation effect analysis showed that career adaptability played a partial mediating role between social support and professional identity, with a mediation effect value of 0.288 (95% CI: 0.221-0.363), accounting for 40.2% of the total effect. Conclusions: Nursing interns' professional identity is at a moderately high level. Social support and career adaptability are positive influencing factors. Career adaptability plays a partial mediating role between social support and professional identity; social support indirectly enhances professional identity by strengthening career adaptability.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：实习期是护生职业价值观形成的关键阶段。本研究旨在调查护理实习生职业认同的现状，分析社会支持、感知压力、心理弹性和生涯适应力对职业认同的影响，并探讨生涯适应力在社会支持与职业认同之间的中介作用，为提升职业认同和优化护理人才培养体系提供实证依据。方法：采用便利抽样法，选取2025年5月至7月泉州市某三级医院的407名护理实习生作为研究对象。采用一般资料问卷、社会支持量表、感知压力量表、心理弹性量表、护生职业认同问卷、生涯适应力量表及护士留职意愿问卷收集数据。使用SPSS 26.0进行信度分析、描述性分析、独立样本t检验、单因素方差分析、Pearson相关分析和多元线性回归分析。采用PROCESS宏检验中介效应。结果：护理实习生职业认同总分为（61.74±11.08），73.5%的护生职业认同处于中等水平。父母对护理的态度、选择专业的原因、个人对专业的态度和就业意愿在职业认同得分上差异有统计学意义（p<0.05）。Pearson相关分析显示，职业认同与社会支持（r=0.474）、心理弹性（r=0.389）和生涯适应力（r=0.609）呈显著正相关（p<0.01），与感知压力呈显著负相关（r=-0.378）（p<0.01）。多元线性回归分析表明，生涯适应力（β=0.309，p<0.001）和社会支持（β=0.383，p<0.001）是职业认同的显著正向预测因素，而选择专业的原因（β=-3.603，p=0.001）和就业意愿（β=-7.116，p<0.001）是显著负向预测因素。该模型解释了职业认同49.2%的变异。中介效应分析显示，生涯适应力在社会支持与职业认同之间起部分中介作用，中介效应值为0.288（95% CI：0.221-0.363），占总效应的40.2%。结论：护理实习生职业认同处于中等偏上水平。社会支持和生涯适应力是正向影响因素。生涯适应力在社会支持与职业认同之间起部分中介作用；社会支持通过增强生涯适应力间接提升职业认同。

papers.title: Mechanisms of action of a community-led HIV prevention and treatment programme for female sex workers in Zimbabwe: a mixed-method analysis
papers.translated_title: 津巴布韦针对女性性工作者的社区主导型HIV预防与治疗项目的作用机制：一项混合方法分析
papers.author: Busza, J.
papers.summary: Background Community-led interventions for female sex workers (FSW) can improve HIV prevention and treatment outcomes by lowering self-stigma and strengthening social cohesion to improve service uptake. In Zimbabwe, the AMETHIST intervention trial integrated peer-led microplanning with self-help groups for FSW and demonstrated improved HIV treatment outcomes. We investigated the role of social cohesion and self-stigma in explaining these findings. Method We conducted a mixed-method analysis of data collected during AMETHIST. We re-analysed qualitative data from interviews and group discussions to identify narratives linking self-stigma, engagement with microplanners and/or self-help groups and HIV service use. We analysed quantitative data from endline respondent-driven sampling surveys for differences in self-reported measures of social cohesion and self-stigma between trial arms, and between those who did and did not participate in intervention activities or access services. Results In both arms, FSW self-reported engaging with peer supporters, participating in self-help groups and accessing HIV services. Qualitative narratives suggested peer support and group participation could reduce self-stigma and support service uptake. Lower levels of self-stigma were seen in the intervention arm (58.6% vs 63.2%; aOR 0.77; 95% CI 0.61-0.86). Social cohesion exceeded 50% across the whole sample, but was not associated with study arm, nor with engagement in intervention-related activities. Discussion Although qualitative data suggested some FSW felt their uptake of services was influenced by intervention components, quantitative analyses did not suggest either variable was on the causal pathway to the outcomes of the intervention. A limitation may have been the measurement of these complex constructs and the high levels of social cohesion across both study arms.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 由社区主导针对女性性工作者（FSW）的干预措施，可通过降低自我污名和增强社会凝聚力来提高服务利用率，从而改善HIV预防和治疗结局。在津巴布韦，AMETHIST干预试验将同伴主导的微观规划与FSW自助小组相结合，并显示出HIV治疗结局的改善。我们研究了社会凝聚力和自我污名在解释这些发现中的作用。方法 我们对AMETHIST期间收集的数据进行了混合方法分析。我们重新分析了来自访谈和小组讨论的定性数据，以识别将自我污名、与微观规划者和/或自助小组的参与以及HIV服务使用联系起来的叙述。我们分析了终线受访者驱动抽样调查的定量数据，以比较试验组之间，以及参与和未参与干预活动或未使用服务者之间，在自我报告的社会凝聚力和自我污名测量上的差异。结果 在两个组中，FSW均自我报告与同伴支持者接触、参与自助小组并获得HIV服务。定性叙述提示，同伴支持和小组参与可减少自我污名并支持服务使用。干预组中观察到较低水平的自我污名（58.6% vs 63.2%；aOR 0.77；95% CI 0.61-0.86）。社会凝聚力在整个样本中超过50%，但与研究组无关，也与参与干预相关活动无关。讨论 尽管定性数据提示部分FSW认为其服务使用受到干预组成部分的影响，但定量分析并未表明这两个变量位于干预结局的因果路径上。一个局限可能是这些复杂构念的测量，以及两个研究组中均具有较高水平的社会凝聚力。

papers.title: DAMPA: compositionally optimised probe panel design for targeted metagenomics
papers.translated_title: DAMPA：用于靶向宏基因组学的组合优化探针面板设计
papers.author: Payne, M.
papers.summary: Probe-based enrichment enables highly sensitive direct-from-sample sequencing, and is being rapidly adopted for clinical metagenomics. Targeted metagenomics requires probe panels that capture hundreds of pathogens at comparable efficiency. However, as target sets expand, existing design methods often fail to account for genomic diversity, leading to overrepresentation of conserved sequences. The resulting composition bias reduces sensitivity precisely at the most clinically important and fast-evolving loci, such as antigenic regions, while increasing redundancy and sequencing cost. Here we show that panel composition bias can be minimised through biologically informed sequence compression. We implement the solution in DAMPA, a computationally efficient tool for metagenomic panel design. DAMPA uses pangenome graphs to compress conserved sequences while retaining genetic diversity, then designs probes from graph-node consensuses. In matched tests on six species, DAMPA successfully minimised composition bias, designing panels with up to 75.8% fewer probes than existing methods. In laboratory validation across four species, DAMPA-designed probes achieved sensitive and quantitative detection at Ct>30. In a highly diverse viral genome (Enterovirus A), where commercial panels retained only 7% of expected read depth, DAMPA-designed probes retained 44%, demonstrating improved robustness to sequence diversity and more uniform coverage. DAMPA enables rapid design of compositionally optimised panels that are cheaper to synthesise, while requiring less sequencing for complete genome coverage.
papers.translated_summary: 基于探针的富集技术实现了高灵敏度的直接样本测序，并正被迅速应用于临床宏基因组学。靶向宏基因组学需要探针面板能够以相当的效率捕获数百种病原体。然而，随着靶标集合的扩大，现有设计方法往往未能充分考虑基因组多样性，导致保守序列过度呈现。由此产生的组成偏差恰恰在临床上最重要且快速演化的位点（如抗原区域）降低了灵敏度，同时增加了冗余度和测序成本。在此，我们表明可以通过生物学信息指导的序列压缩来最小化面板组成偏差。我们将该解决方案实现在DAMPA中，这是一个用于宏基因组面板设计的计算高效工具。DAMPA使用泛基因组图来压缩保守序列，同时保留遗传多样性，然后从图节点共识序列设计探针。在六个物种的匹配测试中，DAMPA成功最小化了组成偏差，设计的面板比现有方法最多减少75.8%的探针。在四个物种的实验室验证中，DAMPA设计的探针在Ct>30时实现了灵敏且定量的检测。在高度多样的病毒基因组（肠道病毒A）中，商业面板仅保留了预期读取深度的7%，而DAMPA设计的探针保留了44%，证明了对序列多样性更好的稳健性和更均匀的覆盖。DAMPA能够快速设计组成优化的面板，其合成成本更低，同时实现完整基因组覆盖所需的测序量更少。

papers.title: Quantitative Facial Phenotyping and Age-Associated Differences in Sickle Cell Disease Using Interpretable Machine Learning
papers.translated_title: 镰状细胞病的定量面部表型分析与年龄相关差异：基于可解释机器学习
papers.author: Spencer, D.
papers.summary: Background Sickle cell disease (SCD) is a common inherited genetic disorder and contributor to global childhood mortality and morbidity, particularly in Sub-Saharan Africa. Craniofacial and skeletal changes have been described in SCD, but the subtle soft-tissue facial patterns and their variation have not been quantitatively characterized using machine-learning methods. Methods: We analyzed 308 front-facing smartphone photographs from 154 participants with electrophoresis-confirmed SCD and 154 age- and sex-matched controls aged from 5 months to 19 years recruited in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo. Predefined geometric and texture-based facial descriptors were extracted from standardized images using manually annotated landmarks. An interpretable linear support vector machine with recursive feature elimination was evaluated using leave-one-out cross-validation, with features ranked according to their relevance for distinguishing participants with SCD from controls. Cross-sectional age- and sex- stratified analyses evaluated variation in selected features Results: The facial analysis algorithm identified eight geometric and six texture discriminative features that were significantly different between the cohorts. A combination of six geometric features contributed most consistently to internal discrimination: distance between medial and lateral canthi, angle at nasal ala, distance from nasion to philtrum, distance from medial canthi to the columella, distance from columella to the lower lip, and distance between nasal alae. The model achieved an AUROC of 0.843 [95% CI: 0.798,0.887], and an accuracy of 0.795 [95% CI: 0.750,0.840]. Between-group difference was limited in the youngest age groups and were more pronounced in several older age groups. Conclusion: These findings demonstrate preliminary evidence that SCD is associated with quantifiable morphometric patterns. External, longitudinal, and clinically characterized studies are needed to determine whether these features may serve as reproducible digital biomarkers within a broader supportive disease-assessment framework.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 镰状细胞病（SCD）是一种常见的遗传性基因疾病，也是全球儿童死亡和发病的重要原因，尤其是在撒哈拉以南非洲。SCD中已描述过颅面和骨骼改变，但其细微的软组织面部模式及其变异尚未通过机器学习方法进行定量表征。方法：我们分析了308张正面智能手机照片，来自154名经电泳确诊的SCD参与者和154名年龄、性别匹配的对照者，年龄从5个月至19岁，招募自刚果民主共和国金沙萨。使用手动标注的解剖标志点从标准化图像中提取预定义的几何和纹理面部描述符。采用留一交叉验证评估具有递归特征消除的可解释线性支持向量机，并根据特征区分SCD参与者与对照者的相关性进行排序。横断面年龄和性别分层分析评估了所选特征的变异。结果：面部分析算法识别出八个几何和六个纹理判别特征，这些特征在队列之间显著不同。六个几何特征的组合对内部判别贡献最一致：内眦与外眦之间的距离、鼻翼处角度、鼻根至人中距离、内眦至鼻小柱距离、鼻小柱至下唇距离，以及鼻翼之间的距离。该模型达到AUROC为0.843 [95% CI: 0.798,0.887]，准确率为0.795 [95% CI: 0.750,0.840]。组间差异在最年轻年龄组中有限，而在若干较年长年龄组中更为明显。结论：这些发现提供了初步证据，表明SCD与可量化的形态测量模式相关。需要外部、纵向和具有临床特征的研究，以确定这些特征是否可在更广泛的支持性疾病评估框架内作为可重复的数字生物标志物。

papers.title: Describing health inequalities without distortion: Simple-Means MAIHDA vs Random-Effects MAIHDA
papers.translated_title: 描述健康不平等而不失真：简单均值MAIHDA与随机效应MAIHDA
papers.author: Merlo, J.
papers.summary: Multilevel Analysis of Individual Heterogeneity and Discriminatory Accuracy (MAIHDA) describes health inequalities through three components: (i) specific contextual effects (SCE), (ii) general contextual effects (GCE), and (iii) discriminatory accuracy of the context. We present Simple-Means MAIHDA (S-MAIHDA), which estimates each stratum directly from its observed individuals, with no distributional assumption. The observed proportions are unbiased whatever the stratum size, and their confidence intervals report the uncertainty honestly. S-MAIHDA operationalises the three components on the probability scale. The SCE are the raw and composition-standardised prevalences, and the exact split of every observed stratum prevalence into a reference, the absolute risk difference (ARD) of its area, the ARD of its sociodemographic stratum common to all areas, and the modification of that ARD by the area. The GCE are the variance partition coefficient (VPC), the standardised contextual area under the ROC curve (coAUC*), which allows comparison across outcomes, and the contextual structuring of the between-stratum inequality, expressed as the contextual clustering of inequalities, the additive sociodemographic differences, and the contextual modification of inequalities (CMI). The contextual discriminatory accuracy is expressed by the contextual area under the ROC curve (coAUC), and the sensitivity and specificity at the population prevalence as the threshold for a possible intervention. Because its estimates are the observed data themselves, S-MAIHDA is the canonical description, and the compare diagnostic quantifies how Random-Effects MAIHDA (RE-MAIHDA), the usual implementation, departs from it: RE shrinkage pulls small strata towards the overall mean and can hide the very inequalities the analysis seeks. Every measure is computed from a table of counts per stratum, so the individual records need not be shared. The approach is implemented in the smaihda Stata command and reproduced in free Python and R code. We illustrate S-MAIHDA in a cross-sectional analysis of 2006 register data from Malmo, Sweden (43,291 individuals; 300 area-sociodemographic strata), showing how the three components separate two contrasting outcomes: psychotropic medication use, almost purely sociodemographic, stable across areas, with weak contextual structuring (VPC {approx} 4%, coAUC* {approx} 63%, CMI {approx} 0%); and choice of a private general practitioner, strongly geographical (VPC {approx} 11%, coAUC* {approx} 72%, CMI {approx} 17%), with the sociodemographic differences reshaped and amplified in wealthy areas. RE-MAIHDA attenuated inequalities. For describing inequalities, S-MAIHDA preserves what the data show.
papers.translated_summary: 个体异质性与歧视准确性的多层次分析（MAIHDA）通过三个组成部分描述健康不平等：（i）特定情境效应（SCE），（ii）一般情境效应（GCE），以及（iii）情境的歧视准确性。我们提出简单均值MAIHDA（S-MAIHDA），它直接从每个层级的观测个体估计该层级，无需分布假设。观测比例无论层级大小如何都是无偏的，其置信区间如实报告不确定性。S-MAIHDA在概率尺度上操作化这三个组成部分。SCE是原始和构成标准化的患病率，以及将每个观测层级患病率精确分解为一个参照值、其地区的绝对风险差（ARD）、其社会人口学层级在所有地区共有的ARD，以及地区对该ARD的修正。GCE是方差分配系数（VPC）、标准化情境ROC曲线下面积（coAUC*），后者允许跨结局比较，以及层级间不平等的情境结构化，表达为不平等的情境聚类、加性社会人口学差异，以及不平等的情境修正（CMI）。情境歧视准确性由情境ROC曲线下面积（coAUC）表示，以及在人群患病率作为可能干预阈值时的敏感性和特异性。由于其估计值就是观测数据本身，S-MAIHDA是典范性描述，而比较诊断量化了随机效应MAIHDA（RE-MAIHDA）——通常的实现方式——偏离它的程度：RE收缩将小层级拉向总体均值，可能掩盖分析所寻求揭示的不平等本身。每个指标都从按层级计数的表中计算，因此个体记录无需共享。该方法在smaihda Stata命令中实现，并在免费的Python和R代码中复现。我们用瑞典马尔默2006年登记数据的横断面分析（43,291名个体；300个地区-社会人口学层级）来说明S-MAIHDA，展示这三个组成部分如何区分两个对比鲜明的结局：精神药物使用，几乎纯粹是社会人口学的，在各地区间稳定，情境结构化较弱（VPC约4%，coAUC*约63%，CMI约0%）；以及选择私人全科医生，强烈具有地理性（VPC约11%，coAUC*约72%，CMI约17%），社会人口学差异在富裕地区被重塑和放大。RE-MAIHDA减弱了不平等。对于描述不平等而言，S-MAIHDA保留了数据所显示的内容。

papers.title: Cognition, Lifestyles, and Environments: Quantifying the Roles of Body Physiology and the Brain
papers.translated_title: 认知、生活方式与环境：量化身体生理与大脑的作用
papers.author: Buianova, I.
papers.summary: Lifestyle and environmental factors are increasingly promoted as modifiable targets for maintaining cognitive health. Yet, it remains unclear how well they predict cognitive functioning and to what extent their associations with cognition are reflected in brain and body measures. We applied machine learning to multimodal data from over 10,000 UK Biobank participants to evaluate the predictive value of twelve lifestyle and environment domains, spanning physical activity, diet, smoking, alcohol consumption, sleep, sexual behavior, electronic device use, and environmental exposures, for cognition, both individually and in combination, and quantified the extent to which these associations are captured by body and brain. A model integrating lifestyle and environment domains explained 23% of the variance in cognition at r=0.48, comparable to body and brain markers. Physical activity, diet, alcohol consumption, sun exposure, and local environment emerged as the strongest predictors. A composite brain marker integrating three neuroimaging modalities accounted for 57.7% of the lifestyle-cognition association, while a composite body marker spanning nine physiological systems accounted for 47.8%. Jointly, lifestyle, environment, body, and brain captured 92.6% of age-related cognitive variation. Therefore, integrating lifestyle and environmental factors enables robust prediction of cognition within the UK Biobank cohort, and much of this association is reflected in brain and bodily health. However, the generalizability of these findings to broader populations requires further evaluation.
papers.translated_summary: 生活方式和环境因素日益被视为维持认知健康的可干预目标。然而，目前尚不清楚它们对认知功能的预测能力有多强，以及它们与认知的关联在多大程度上反映在大脑和身体指标中。我们对来自超过10,000名英国生物银行参与者的多模态数据应用机器学习，评估十二个生活方式和环境领域（涵盖体力活动、饮食、吸烟、饮酒、睡眠、性行为、电子设备使用和环境暴露）对认知的预测价值，包括单独和联合评估，并量化这些关联被身体和大脑所捕捉的程度。一个整合生活方式和环境领域的模型解释了认知方差的23%，r=0.48，与身体和大脑标志物相当。体力活动、饮食、饮酒、日照和当地环境是最强的预测因素。一个整合三种神经影像模态的复合大脑标志物解释了生活方式-认知关联的57.7%，而一个涵盖九个生理系统的复合身体标志物解释了47.8%。生活方式、环境、身体和大脑共同捕捉了92.6%的年龄相关认知变异。因此，整合生活方式和环境因素能够在英国生物银行队列中稳健地预测认知，且这种关联的很大一部分反映在大脑和身体健康中。然而，这些发现对更广泛人群的普遍适用性仍需进一步评估。

papers.title: A national ecosystem for long-read genome sequencing: Integrating population genomics and rare disease diagnostics in Sweden
papers.translated_title: 瑞典长读长基因组测序的国家生态系统：整合群体基因组学与罕见病诊断
papers.author: Ameur, A.
papers.summary: To evaluate the clinical implementation of long-read genome sequencing (lrGS) and establish the population reference resources needed to support its use in diagnostics, we integrate two complementary initiatives: Genome of Sweden (GoS), Sweden's contribution to Genome of Europe (GoE), and the Genomic Medicine Sweden - Rare Diseases (GMS-RD) long-read sequencing pilot. The initial GoS release of 576 individuals provides population-scale maps of genetic and epigenetic variation. Among 485 GMS-RD probands, 161 (33.2%) receive a molecular diagnosis, with lrGS providing added clinical value in 40 (24.8%). As a first-line test, lrGS could have avoided at least 42 follow-up analyses and an additional testing cycle in 7.2% of probands, reducing costs and the burden on patients. By integrating population and clinical long-read genomics, Sweden establishes a national ecosystem for genomic research and clinical diagnostics. Our findings support the clinical implementation of lrGS and offer a scalable model for national collaboration.
papers.translated_summary: 为评估长读长基因组测序（lrGS）的临床实施，并建立支持其在诊断中应用所需的人群参考资源，我们整合了两项互补性计划：瑞典基因组计划（GoS），即瑞典对欧洲基因组计划（GoE）的贡献，以及瑞典基因组医学-罕见病（GMS-RD）长读长测序试点。GoS首批发布的576名个体提供了群体尺度的遗传和表观遗传变异图谱。在485名GMS-RD先证者中，161名（33.2%）获得分子诊断，其中lrGS在40名（24.8%）中提供了额外临床价值。作为一线检测，lrGS本可避免至少42次后续分析，并在7.2%的先证者中避免额外一轮检测，从而降低成本和患者负担。通过整合群体与临床长读长基因组学，瑞典建立了用于基因组研究和临床诊断的国家生态系统。我们的发现支持lrGS的临床实施，并提供了一个可扩展的国家协作模式。

papers.title: inClinico Agent for clinical trial endpoint prediction and prospective evaluation
papers.translated_title: 用于临床试验终点预测和前瞻性评估的inClinico智能体
papers.author: Chen, J.
papers.summary: High attrition rates across clinical drug development impose immense clinical and financial burdens, yet prospectively forecasting whether an individual trial will achieve its primary endpoint remains challenging. Here we present a machine-learning system that predicts clinical trial success across phases I-IV, independently modeling studies with efficacy versus safety/toxicity primary endpoints. To prevent lookahead bias and outcome leakage, models are trained on registration-time features, including target and mechanism-of-action precedent, drug modality and novelty, trial design and operational characteristics, and frozen literature-derived target-choice embeddings. Each prediction yields a continuous Predictive Trial Index (PTI) between 0 and 1 reflecting success probability. On a test set of trials initiated in 2021 or later, the efficacy model achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.828 (95% CI 0.812-0.845; n = 2,347) and the safety/toxicity model reached 0.809 (95% CI 0.787-0.831; n = 1,485). These models are embedded in inClinico Agent, an agentic AI system integrating frontier large language models (LLMs) with deterministic scoring engines, retrieval tools and specialized clinical skills. We also introduce ClinBench, a prospective benchmark of 2,040 ongoing trials evaluated by inClinico Agent and five frontier LLMs, establishing a leakage-free foundation for tracking prospective predictive accuracy as trials reach completion.
papers.translated_summary: 临床试验药物开发中的高流失率带来了巨大的临床和经济负担，但前瞻性预测单个试验能否达到其主要终点仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出一个机器学习系统，可预测I-IV期临床试验的成功率，并分别对以疗效为主要终点和以安全性/毒性为主要终点的研究进行建模。为防止前视偏差和结局泄漏，模型基于注册时特征进行训练，包括靶点和作用机制的先例、药物模态和新颖性、试验设计和运营特征，以及冻结的文献衍生靶点选择嵌入。每个预测都会产生一个介于0到1之间的连续预测试验指数（PTI），反映成功概率。在2021年或之后启动的试验测试集上，疗效模型的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）达到0.828（95% CI 0.812-0.845；n = 2,347），安全性/毒性模型达到0.809（95% CI 0.787-0.831；n = 1,485）。这些模型嵌入于inClinico Agent中，这是一个代理式AI系统，将前沿大型语言模型（LLM）与确定性评分引擎、检索工具和专门临床技能相结合。我们还引入了ClinBench，这是一个由inClinico Agent和五个前沿LLM评估的2,040项正在进行试验的前瞻性基准，为在试验完成时跟踪前瞻性预测准确性建立了无泄漏基础。
